title: Tự học: Prompt Design in Vertex AI (Google) — khóa 3 theo phân vai

result.notes: Da hoc xong khoa Prompt Design in Vertex AI (Google, ~3h45, 4 lab): giai phau prompt, temperature/top-K/top-P, zero/one/few-shot, system/role/contextual, CoT, self-consistency, ToT, ReAct, step-back, APE, bien generative thanh classification, multimodal, GenAI SDK, Gen AI Evaluation Service, Responsible AI.
